articles.title: CleoPtolemy made with Midjourney
articles.author: Nixal Patel
articles.content: CleoPtolemy made with Midjourney Content filters can block unsafe output. They cannot tell you whether an agent was authorized to issue that refund, touch that production system, or commit the company to an external action. Those are different problems, and most enterprises are only solving the first one.
headings: Your agent didn’t hallucinate; it exceeded its authority
